question: In March 2025, PM Modi also disbursed Rs. ____ crore in financial assistance at 'Lakhpati Didi Sammelan' in Gujarat.
solution:
The correct answer is __**450 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PM Modi** disbursed a financial assistance of **Rs. 450 crore** at the **'Lakhpati Didi Sammelan'** event held in Gujarat in March 2025.
 
• The **'Lakhpati Didi Sammelan'** is organized to empower women and promote self-help groups (SHGs) in rural areas.
 
• The assistance aims to benefit women associated with SHGs under various government schemes, promoting financial inclusion and entrepreneurship.
 
• Gujarat has been a key state for implementing women-centric initiatives, with a focus on enhancing the socio-economic status of rural women.
 
• The funds are provided to support businesses and livelihoods of women under the umbrella of government-backed programs.
